description: SCAU timetable: sign-in schedule plus the official academic calendar (holidays and makeup days override the timetable), semester progress, editable courses, and Home / Lock Screen widgets.

localizedDescriptions.en: SCAU timetable + official academic calendar: holidays and makeup days override classes, build your own courses on a blank grid, dark mode, semester progress, and Home / Lock Screen widgets.
